variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single landscape 16:9 polished Roblox Ball Ocean Depths environment concept. Input images are STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCES ONLY: retain their very long straight wide football lane in diagonal perspective from large lower-left foreground to distant upper-right endpoint, elevated 3/4 view, blocky handmade faceted toy-brick forms with square studs. Create a NEW Vent Fields underwater hydrothermal environment; remove ships, kelp and ordinary coral landmarks. Main landmarks are hollow BLACK BASALT STONE CHIMNEYS emitting dense underwater dark blue-grey mineral PLUMES from their open mouths, and white tubular worms with vivid RED feathered tops clustered at bases. Every chimney and all terrain stand on full broad visible bases integrated into seabed, no floating rocks or half-supported objects. Thick plumes rise vertically over SIDE banks only; central lane and all space above it remain completely unobstructed, no smoke across lane. Light pale mineral/sand checked central lane, thin white football markings and turquoise edges maintain Ocean Depths visual connection. Cool saturated blue water, clear readable terrain, localized restrained warm copper-orange mineral stains near vents. NO glowing lava, magma rivers, volcanic eruption, fire, burning worms, grey apocalypse, photorealism, text, labels, UI, logos, collage, crossing bridge. Plumes are underwater particulate fluid columns, not flames or surface steam. COMPOSITION A: relatively low open basin, a large cluster of varied short and medium black octagonal smoking chimney tubes at left foreground and midground, smaller spaced clusters on right, wide white and cream mineral rims on low BLUE rock terraces, pale sand between clusters. Distinct giant flared chimney in left third, thick blue-grey plumes into clear bright azure water. Rich white red-tipped worm gardens wrap bases, bright cool daylight and subtle warm ochre stains.
